```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# Specify the path to your folder
folder_path <- "/Users/kyliealberts/Desktop/AMS_A"

# List all CSV files in the folder
csv_files <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Function to check if a CSV file has a specific column
has_verification_code <- function(file_path) {
  # Read only the first row to check column names
  data <- read_csv(file_path, n_max = 1, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  # Check if 'Finish.timesOff' column exists
  return("Finish.timesOff" %in% colnames(data))
}

# Initialize an empty dataframe to store all data
all_data <- tibble()

# Loop through files, load and append if it has the column
for(file_path in csv_files) {
  if(has_verification_code(file_path)) {
    # Load the CSV file
    data <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
    
    # Force participant column to character if it exists
    if ("participant" %in% colnames(data)) {
      data$participant <- as.character(data$participant)
      data$textbox_comp.text <- as.character(data$textbox_comp.text)
      data$textbox_comp_2.text <- as.character(data$textbox_comp_2.text)
      data$bruinID.text <- as.character(data$bruinID.text)
    }

    # Append to the master dataframe
    all_data <- bind_rows(all_data, data)
  } else {
    cat("Skipping file, does not have 'Finish.timesOff' column:", file_path, "\n")
  }
}
```

```{r}
#calculating questionnaires
all_data_ss_y <- all_data %>% select(participant, slider1.response, ss_question)
all_data_ss_y <- na.omit(all_data_ss_y)

all_data_ss_y$slider1.response.reverse <- 8 - all_data_ss_y$slider1.response

all_data_ss_y <- all_data_ss_y %>%
  mutate(
    ss_answer = case_when(
      str_detect(ss_question, "65") ~ as.character(slider1.response),
      str_detect(ss_question, "difficulty") ~ as.character(slider1.response.reverse),
      str_detect(ss_question, "rings") ~ as.character(slider1.response.reverse),
      str_detect(ss_question, "something") ~ as.character(slider1.response),
      str_detect(ss_question, "usually") ~ as.character(slider1.response.reverse),
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

all_data_ss_y <- all_data_ss_y %>%
  group_by(participant) %>%
  summarise(total_ss_answer = sum(as.numeric(ss_answer), na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
#calculating questionnaires
all_data_ss_o <- all_data_o %>% select(participant, slider1.response, ss_question)
all_data_ss_o <- na.omit(all_data_ss_o)

all_data_ss_o$slider1.response.reverse <- 8 - all_data_ss_o$slider1.response

all_data_ss_o <- all_data_ss_o %>%
  mutate(
    ss_answer = case_when(
      str_detect(ss_question, "65") ~ as.character(slider1.response),
      str_detect(ss_question, "difficulty") ~ as.character(slider1.response.reverse),
      str_detect(ss_question, "rings") ~ as.character(slider1.response.reverse),
      str_detect(ss_question, "something") ~ as.character(slider1.response),
      str_detect(ss_question, "usually") ~ as.character(slider1.response.reverse),
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

all_data_ss_o <- all_data_ss_o %>%
  group_by(participant) %>%
  summarise(total_ss_answer = sum(as.numeric(ss_answer), na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
# Function to tag chunk number per participant
tag_chunks <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(participant) %>%
    mutate(
      chunk = {
        # chunk id increases every time a row has NA in figure2
        is_na_row <- is.na(figure2)
        chunk_id <- cumsum(lag(is_na_row, default = FALSE)) + 1
        chunk_id
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}


df_tagged <- tag_chunks(all_data_small) 
df_tagged <- subset(df_tagged, chunk != 1)
df_updated <- subset(df_tagged, chunk != 3)
```

```{r}
df_joined_all$total_ss_answer <- as.numeric(as.character(df_joined_all$total_ss_answer))


honesty_model <- lmer(textbox_comp.text ~ label2 * Time * Type * agegroup + (1 | participant) + (1|figure2), data = df_joined_all)
summary(honesty_model)
```

```{r}

# Install and load emmeans 
library(emmeans)


emmeans_type <- emmeans(honesty_model, pairwise ~ label2)
summary(emmeans_type)

emmeans_age <- emmeans(honesty_model, pairwise ~ agegroup)
summary(emmeans_age)

emmeans_type2 <- emmeans(honesty_model, pairwise ~ Type)
summary(emmeans_type2)

# Post-hoc comparisons for 
emmeans_label_time <- emmeans(honesty_model, pairwise ~ label2 * Time)
summary(emmeans_label_time)

# Post-hoc comparisons for 
emmeans_label_type <- emmeans(honesty_model, pairwise ~ label2 * Type)
summary(emmeans_label_type)


# Interaction effects for 
emmeans_interaction_t_a <- emmeans(honesty_model, ~ pairwise ~ agegroup * Type)
summary(emmeans_interaction_t_a)

# Pairwise comparisons within each interaction level
emmeans_pairwise_interaction <- emmeans(honesty_model, pairwise ~ label2 * Time * Type)
summary(emmeans_pairwise_interaction)
```

```{r}
##creating graph for honesty ratings
stand_honesty <- data.frame(
  label2=c("Neutral", "Neutral", "Neutral", "Neutral", "Scam", "Scam", "Scam", "Scam", "None", "None", "None", "None"),
  Time = c("Pre", "Pre", "Post", "Post", "Pre", "Pre", "Post", "Post", "Pre", "Pre", "Post", "Post"),
  Type = c("artificial", "real","artificial", "real","artificial", "real","artificial", "real","artificial", "real","artificial", "real"),
  sd=c(.156, .121, .181, .150, .160, .136, .167, .170, .171, .128, .191, .151)
)
df_joined$textbox_comp.text <- as.numeric(df_joined$textbox_comp.text)

average_honesty <- df_joined %>% 
  group_by(label2, Time, Type, agegroup) %>% summarise_at(vars(textbox_comp.text), list(textbox_comp.text = mean))

average_honesty_young <- average_honesty %>% subset(agegroup == "Young")

average_honesty_young$Time <- factor(average_honesty_young$Time, levels = c("Pre", "Post"))
average_honesty_young$Type <- factor(average_honesty_young$Type, levels = c("real", "artificial"))
average_honesty_young$label2 <- factor(average_honesty_young$label2, levels = c("Scam", "Neutral", "None"))

average_honesty_young<- merge(average_honesty_young, stand_honesty, by=c("label2","Time", "Type"))

average_honesty_young$Type <- gsub("artificial", "Artificial", average_honesty_young$Type)
average_honesty_young$Type <- gsub("real", "Real", average_honesty_young$Type)
average_honesty_young$Type <- factor(average_honesty_young$Type, levels = c("Real", "Artificial"))

annotation_hy <- data.frame(
  x = c(1.75, 2, 2, 1, 1),
  y = c(6.25, 4.75, 4.75, 6, 6),
  label = c("***", "***", "***", "*", "***"),
  label2 = c("Neutral", "None", "Scam", "Neutral", "Scam")  # Must match facet variable!
)
annotation_hy$label2 <- factor(annotation_hy$label2, levels = c("Scam", "Neutral", "None"))

segment_df_hy <- data.frame(
  x = c(1.25, 1.75, 1.75, .75, .75),            # "real" is at x=1 (left bar)
  xend = c(2.25, 2.25, 2.25, 1.25, 1.25),         # "artificial" is at x=2 (right bar)
  y = c(6, 4.5, 4.5, 5.75, 5.75),         # vertical position of line
  yend = c(6, 4.5, 4.5, 5.75, 5.75),
  label2 = c("Neutral", "None", "Scam", "Neutral", "Scam")
)


segment_df_hy$label2 <- factor(segment_df_hy$label2, levels = c("Scam", "Neutral", "None"))

figure_honesty1_bw <- ggplot(data = average_honesty_young, 
                             aes(x = Type, y = textbox_comp.text, fill = Time)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(), col = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~label2) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = FALSE, direction = "horizontal")) +  # 🔹 horizontal
  labs(x = " ", y = "Honesty Rating") +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Times New Roman") +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'transparent'),
    legend.position = c(0.85, 0.8),   # 🔹 inside panel
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA), # optional box
    legend.key = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", size = .3),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", size = .3),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("black", "white"), name = "") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = textbox_comp.text - sd, ymax = textbox_comp.text + sd),
                width = 0.2, colour = "gray27", position = position_dodge(.9)) +
  ylim(0, 10)

figure_honesty1_bw
```

```{r}
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", size = .3),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", size = .3),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("black", "white"), name = "") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = textbox_comp.text - sd, ymax = textbox_comp.text + sd),
                width = 0.2, colour = "gray27", position = position_dodge(.9)) +
  ylim(0, 10)
```

```{r}
##accuracy LME
df_acc_all$label2 <- as.factor(df_acc_all$label2)
df_acc_all$agegroup <- as.factor(df_acc_all$agegroup)
df_acc_all$figure2 <- as.factor(df_acc_all$figure2)
df_acc_all$participant <- as.factor(df_acc_all$participant)
df_acc_all$type <- as.factor(df_acc_all$type)
df_acc_all$total_ss_answer <- as.numeric(as.character(df_acc_all$total_ss_answer))


df_acc_all$total_ss_answer_c <- scale(df_acc_all$total_ss_answer, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
#accuracy
accuracy_model <- glmer(accurate ~ label2*type*agegroup + (1 | participant) + (1 | figure2), data = df_acc_all, family = binomial)
summary(accuracy_model)

```

```{r}
# Pairwise comparisons within each interaction level
emmeans_pairwise_aage <- emmeans(accuracy_model, pairwise ~ agegroup, type = "response")
summary(emmeans_pairwise_aage)

emmeans_pairwise_acc <- emmeans(accuracy_model, pairwise ~ type*agegroup, type = "response")
summary(emmeans_pairwise_acc)

conf_intervals_int_age <- confint(emmeans_pairwise_aage)
print(conf_intervals_int_age)

conf_intervals_int <- confint(emmeans_pairwise_acc)
print(conf_intervals_int)
```

```{r}
#accuracy and confidence
library(purrr)
library(cocor)

df_con_all %>%
  group_by(agegroup, participant) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_textbox = mean(textbox_comp_2.text, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_accurate = mean(accurate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(agegroup) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  map_df(~{
    result <- cor.test(~ mean_textbox + mean_accurate, data = .x)
    tibble(
      agegroup = unique(.x$agegroup),
      correlation = result$estimate,
      p_value = result$p.value,
      df = result$parameter 
    )
  })

df_avg <- df_con_all %>%
  group_by(agegroup, participant) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_textbox = mean(textbox_comp_2.text, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_accurate = mean(accurate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

df_avg$agegroup <- factor(df_avg$agegroup, levels = c("Young", "Older"))

# Plot the data
ggplot(df_avg, aes(x = mean_accurate, y = mean_textbox, color = agegroup)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, fullrange = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ agegroup) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "Accuracy",
    y = "Confidence",
    color = "Age Group"
  ) 
  #theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

```
